nodes.label: WhatsApp delivery is manual/deferred
nodes.rationale: Contractor sends the link from their own number; system records SHARE_INTENT_OPENED, never 'delivered'. Cloud API auto-send and A2 e-signature exist as adapters but are not wired to a real provider.

nodes.label: Lint-enforced dependency direction
nodes.rationale: eslint.config.mjs enforces domain never imports db/integrations/files/runtime, and apps/web only imports @extrawork/contracts; tests/testkit/scripts/cli are exempt.

nodes.label: Sent version is frozen
nodes.rationale: Sending builds a canonical JSON snapshot (RFC 8785/JCS), SHA-256 hashes it, and stores it permanently; edits create version n+1 and revoke the old token rather than mutating.

nodes.label: Modular monolith architecture
nodes.rationale: Three processes (api/worker/web) share one domain codebase and one Postgres database; no network boundary at runtime, only enforced at build/lint time.

nodes.label: Money is never a float
nodes.rationale: Integer paise as bigint end-to-end; lint hard-errors on parseFloat/Math.round in domain/application/db in favor of parseQuantity and roundHalfUpToBigint.

nodes.label: No provider call inside a transaction
nodes.rationale: All side effects (WhatsApp, email, PDF) go through a transactional outbox + Postgres job queue (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, leases, backoff, dead-letter) consumed by apps/worker.
nodes.norm_label: no provider call inside a transaction

nodes.label: Real WhatsApp Implementation Gap
nodes.rationale: Outbound sends still use plain text instead of approved templates, inbound messages[] events aren't parsed, media isn't wired to evidence pipeline, and Meta cannot reach a local/LAN webhook — must not be declared production-ready until all seven gaps close.

nodes.label: Meta Messaging Cost Expectation
nodes.rationale: No monthly platform fee; per-message India utility rate (~Rs 0.115) as of Jan 2026, scaling to roughly Rs 1,150 per 10,000 messages.

nodes.label: WABA Ownership Decision
nodes.rationale: First pilot should run under the construction client's own Meta Business Portfolio/WABA and legal entity to avoid premature ExtraWork incorporation; multi-customer SaaS later requires ExtraWork's own verified identity and Embedded Signup.

nodes.label: Performance Investigation and Changes
nodes.rationale: Latency after Supabase migration was caused by repeated round trips to Mumbai from a local dev machine; mitigated via connection pooling, keepalive, single auth projection query, caching, and parallelized reads, though the real fix is co-locating compute with the database.

nodes.label: Report-Deferred WhatsApp/E-Sign Items
nodes.rationale: Report §10.3 deferred automated WhatsApp until proven and §15.2 deferred e-signatures; the founder's pivot deliberately overrides both.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Product Pivot
nodes.rationale: Founder redefined the product so the employee's entire interface is one WhatsApp message; overrides report §10.3 (native-share only) and §15.2 (e-sign deferred).

nodes.label: MVP Deferred-Adapter Posture
nodes.rationale: Deferred providers (WhatsApp Cloud API, A2 e-sign) are built as real interfaces with a working default driver, so the deferred item is one config switch away but never silently substituted.

nodes.label: ExtraWork product concept
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp-first contract-change/approval ledger letting customers approve without creating an account.

nodes.label: TenantContext / TransactionContext
nodes.rationale: Highest-fan-out abstractions; nearly every repository method takes one, so an unscoped repository method is very likely a tenant-isolation bug.

nodes.label: docs/HANDOFF*.md handoffs
nodes.rationale: Point-in-time snapshots; dates must be checked against current work before trusting 'done' claims.

nodes.label: Evidence is append-only
nodes.rationale: audit_events and decisions are protected by DB triggers and revoked UPDATE/DELETE privileges; corrections only via the audited pnpm db:repair command.

nodes.label: Boot-time config/secret validation
nodes.rationale: packages/config refuses to start with APP_ENV=production if secrets are dev placeholders, storage driver is local, email can't deliver, or DB TLS is off.

nodes.label: Decisions Atomic and Idempotent
nodes.rationale: Decision + audit + projection + outbox commit in one transaction; a unique constraint allows at most one decision per version so races resolve to one winner.

nodes.label: Evidence Is Append-Only
nodes.rationale: Enforced by DB triggers and revoked role privileges; corrections only via an audited repair command that records before/after digests.

nodes.label: Sent Version Is Frozen
nodes.rationale: Send freezes an RFC 8785 canonical JSON snapshot + SHA-256 digest; later edits create a new version and revoke the old token instead of mutating history.

nodes.label: Money Never a Float
nodes.rationale: Integer minor units end to end; one engine computes every total so a client preview can never become authoritative.

nodes.label: No Provider Call Inside a Transaction
nodes.rationale: Side effects route through a transactional outbox and a Postgres job queue (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) so provider latency never holds a DB lock.
nodes.norm_label: no provider call inside a transaction

nodes.label: Tenant Scoping Mandatory
nodes.rationale: A cross-tenant reference returns NOT_FOUND rather than FORBIDDEN so an attacker cannot confirm an ID exists elsewhere.

nodes.label: pnpm openapi
nodes.rationale: Regenerates docs/openapi/openapi.json; CI checks for drift after route-schema changes.

nodes.label: migrations job (idempotency check)
nodes.rationale: Re-applies migrations and asserts 'No new migrations' to prove migrations are idempotent.

nodes.label: Decisions are atomic and idempotent
nodes.rationale: Decision + audit events + projection update + outbox event commit in one transaction; unique constraint limits one decision per version, races resolve to 409 ALREADY_DECIDED.

nodes.label: Launch Blocker Gates (§16.3)
nodes.rationale: Launch-blocker jobs are kept as separate CI jobs so a failure names the specific blocker instead of a generic 'tests failed'.

nodes.label: Agreed Product Sequence
nodes.rationale: Founder-required build order: owner site, then simulate WhatsApp, then integrate views, then migrate storage, then real WhatsApp Business Platform integration.

nodes.label: Security and Evidence Invariants
nodes.rationale: Money as integer minor units, immutable sent versions, atomic decision transactions, tenant scoping, append-only evidence with restricted roles, and webhook signature verification protect against fraud and disputes.

nodes.label: Customer WhatsApp Transcript PDF (Missing)
nodes.rationale: Requested but not implemented; must omit or irreversibly redact any uncompleted private approval URL if built.

nodes.label: Company Field Optional Decision
nodes.rationale: Sender phone already identifies the employer, so requiring retyped company/project adds friction with no security benefit.

nodes.label: Parser Refuses to Guess
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous amounts or ambiguous project matches trigger a clarifying reply rather than a silent guess, because a wrong guess becomes the price/recipient in a signed contract.

nodes.label: 24-Hour Template Window Rule
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp only permits free-form replies within 24h of the person messaging first; outbound-first messages to the customer must use a pre-approved UTILITY template with a dynamic URL button.
